caption: A smiling shepherd leaning on a crook and wearing a wooly covering, standing with his back to row of riot police.
Los Angeles, US Welsh actor Matthew Rhys wins outstanding lead actor in a comedy for Widow’s Bay and outstanding lead actor in a limited series for his role in The Beast in Me at the Emmys.
Los Angeles, US Actor Megan Stalter arrives for the 78th Emmy awards dressed up as a life-sized Emmy statuette.

Gaza City, Gaza Supporters chant as they carry the body of Ahmed al-Batsh, a commander of al-Qassam Brigades – the military wing of Hamas – for burial after he was killed by an Israeli airstrike on his car.
Aden, Yemen A fisher at Sirah fish market.
Düzce, Turkey A praying mantis (Mantis religiosa). The predatory insect is characterised by its remarkable triangular head, capable of turning 180 degrees.
Bucharest, Romania A shepherd stands in front of a row of riot police during a farming protest.
Bucharest, Romania Riot police spray teargas after scuffles with demonstrators during a protest against EU farming policies.
Springfield, US Denise Gedeon, the wife of pastor Joubert Adrien, who was detained by ICE, spends an entire night and day praying for her husband.
Beaufort, France French-Swiss artist Guillaume Legros, known as Saype, works on his latest giant fresco depicting a human hand clutching a dog’s paw on a mountain pasture above the Col de la Laie.
Inner Mongolia, China An improved version of the Zhuque-2E Y7 carrier rocket blasts off from the Dongfeng commercial space innovation pilot zone. The rocket deployed 10 networking satellites.

Fos-sur-Mer, France Riot police stand by a pallet fire after removing several dozen fishers blocking an oil depot in the port to protest against rising fuel prices and deteriorating working conditions.
Hokkaido, Japan US army paratroopers jump out of a USAF C-130J Super Hercules during a joint airborne exercise.

Kathmandu, Nepal Devotees offer prayers on the banks of the Bagmati River at the end of the three-day Teej festival, in which Hindu women fast during the day and pray for the long lives of their husbands.

A woman in black sunglasses is playing a double-ended hand drum that is hung around her neck. She is in front other women, some of whom appear to be singing and dancing, and all are dressed in red and gold.
Quito, Ecuador People form a human chain to fight a wildfire near their neighbourhood.
Banjarmasin, Indonesia Rescue teams evacuate a survivor after a passenger ferry capsized due to bad weather while carrying 243 people.
Al-Mawasi, Gaza Strip A displaced Palestinian boy inspects damage to a tent after an Israeli drone strike.
Aleppo, Syria A protester burns tyres during a demonstration about the increase in fuel prices.

Cotabato City, the Philippines Supporters of a political group cheer after destroying a vehicle believed to contain firearms during the first parliamentary elections of the Bangsamoro autonomous region in Muslim Mindanao.
Dhading, Nepal A man walks along a mud-covered road near his house that was damaged in last month’s deadly floods.
South Carolina, US A young child plays in the sand as a storm passes off shore in Isle of Palms.

Scheveningen, the Netherlands Members of the cavalry honorary escort practise on the beach before Prinsjesdag (Prince’s Day), when the monarch travels to deliver the speech from the throne in The Hague.
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil A supporter of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attends a political rally at Copacabana beach.
Kuwait City, Kuwait Students arrive for the first day of school after the three-month summer holidays.
Mumbai, India Devotees put an idol of the Hindu deity Ganesha on to the back of a truck during the Ganesh Chaturthi festival.
Vatican City Street artist JR poses in front of his work Diluvium, at the Vatican Apostolic Library, during the inauguration of the exhibition Catastrophe and Wonder.
Liudmyla Ryzhak, in her wedding dress, sits amid glass-strewn debris in her damaged Kyiv apartment.

Jersey City, New Jersey, US People observe a minute of silence honouring the victims of the September 11 terrorist attacks. The US marked the 25th anniversary with memorials and remembrance ceremonies across the country to honour the nearly 3,000 people killed.

New York City, US A US army warrant officer stands by a reflecting pool during a memorial on the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks. Family members of victims gathered at the 9/11 Memorial Plaza as the names of those killed in the 9/11 attacks and the bombing of the World Trade Centre in 1993 were read aloud.

Kandahar, Afghanistan Girls attend a class at a primary school in Kandahar at the start of a new school year. Hundreds of thousands of Afghan women and girls have been deported from Iran and Pakistan in the past year to a life of severe restrictions.

Deir al-Balah, Gaza A Palestinian child looks at the funeral of three-year-old Saadi Ghalia, who was killed by an Israeli tank shell, in Deir al-Balah. Testimony from 24 Israeli military insiders ​on the secret ​systems used in ​the war on Gaza​ has been revealed in a new documentary film about the mass killing of Palestinian civilians .
Gaza Palestinians inspect the site of an Israeli strike on a house, carried out after the Israeli military warned residents to evacuate the area, at al-Shati camp in Gaza City.

Taybeh, West Bank Members of the Bedouin community from the West Bank village of Taybeh keep guard to prevent attacks by Israeli settlers from the nearby outpost. Prominent British rabbis have backed sanctions by Ed Miliband, the foreign secretary , on Israeli settlements, warning that the time for inaction on settler violence must come to an end.
Ceuta, Spain People look on as firefighters and police work in an area where a fire broke out, burning improvised migrant shelters.
Barcelona, Spain Police officers use batons to disperse far-left Catalan separatists trying to disrupt a rally by a far-right Catalan separatist party.

Kyiv, Ukraine Firefighters deal with the aftermath of a huge Russian missile and drone attack in Kyiv. Recent Russian strikes on food warehouses and logistics supply chains around several Ukrainian cities have left gaps on supermarket shelves and fears of price increases.

Kyiv, Ukraine A resident walks by a building hit during Russian missile and drone strikes in Kyiv. Ukraine’s capital has been attacked by a torrent of drone and missile strikes since late August, killing dozens of people and destroying infrastructure. As well as food warehouses, Russia has targeted e-commerce logistics hubs and stockpiles of medical supplies.
Palembang, Indonesia A firefighter uses a tree branch to try to extinguish flames amid a wildfire in Palembang .
Surakarta, Indonesia A helicopter drops water in an attempt to put out a fire at the Putri Cempo landfill.

Devighat, Nepal Residents commute across the Trishuli River on a newly installed zip wire in the aftermath of flash floods in Devighat. Nepal is demanding $20m (£15m) in climate compensation for the recent devastating floods, as a senior minister called on the world’s most polluting countries to ‘wake up’ and accept shared responsibility for a disaster that led to the death or disappearance of more than 6,000 people.

Nuwakot, Nepal Members of the Nepali army search and rescue team run for cover from heavy rain while looking for survivors beneath the mud in an area hit by flash floods and mudslides. Scientists believe the climate crisis had a role to play in the floods , which were triggered when a melting glacier partly collapsed and set off a deadly landslide and flash flooding through Chinese-controlled Tibet and Nepal in late August.
Bukavu, Democratic Republic of the Congo A girl stands among the debris of a fire that ravaged a school in Bukavu. The fire caused a stampede that killed at least 14 children.
Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo Health workers prepare to transfer the body of Abineno Justine, a 38-year-old woman who died of the Ebola virus, to a coffin before her burial.
Havana, Cuba Followers of the Virgin of Regla – Yemayá in the Yoruba religion – take part in a procession during her feast day in Havana.

New York City, US Aryna Sabalenka of Belarus serves to Czechia’s Linda Nosková during the women’s quarter-final at the US Open in Flushing Meadows. There has been little evidence of vulnerability from Sabalenka during the tournament. She swept through Camila Osorio, Polina Iatcenko, Kamilla Rakhimova and Taylor Townsend without dropping a set before surviving her first serious examination against the Wimbledon champion Nosková in Tuesday’s quarter-final, coming through 7-6, 3-6, 7-6 after 2 hours and 22 minutes.

Jersey City, New Jersey, US People embrace at Liberty State Park during testing of the 9/11 Tribute in Light installation. Thousands gathered across the country on the 25th anniversary of the terrorist attacks to honour the memory of the victims.
